info.name: LYBTZYZS - 凌隐宝堂中医诊所管理系统 API
info.description:
凌隐宝堂中医诊所管理系统 (TCM Clinic Management System) RESTful API Collection

Base URL: https://localhost:5001/api/v1
Auth: JWT Bearer Token
Response Format: ApiResponse<T> with success, message, data, errors, timestamp, requestId
Pagination: PagedResult<T> with items, totalCount, currentPage, pageSize, totalPages, hasPreviousPage, hasNextPage

User Roles: Receptionist=0, Doctor=1, Admin=10, SuperAdmin=100
Gender: Unknown=0, Male=1, Female=2
MedicalCaseStatus: Suspended, Active, Completed
DecocteMethod: Default=0, PreDecoct=1, PostAdd=2, MeltIn=3, TakeWithWater=4, WrapDecoct=5, SeparateDecoct=6
CommonStatus: Enabled=0, Disabled=1
PrintType: Prescription=0
